bugs.title: Canonical role migration smoke tests still assert legacy lattice reviewer lanes

evidence.symptom: Configured validation failed because canonical reviewer outputs were compared against lattice-review-* literals in two smoke tests
evidence.hypothesis: The role-ID migration changed production outputs to proof-or-stop-review-* while smoke assertions retained legacy output expectations
evidence.rootCause: Two migration smoke tests asserted retired lattice reviewer lane strings for canonical output
evidence.fixEvidence: Updated only canonical output assertions; legacy agent input remains covered; both focused smoke tests now pass
